messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: ur5e-manual, p. 238

21. Safety Functions Table Description UR e-Series robots comply with ISO 10218-1:2011 and the applicable portions of ISO/TS 15066. It is important to note that most of ISO/TS 15066 is directed towards the integrator and not the robot manufacturer. ISO 10218-1:2011, clause 5.10 collaborative operation details 4 collaborative operation techniques as explained below. It is very important to understand that collaborative operation is of the APPLICATION when in AUTOMATIC mode. Collaborative Technique Explanation UR e-Series Operation Stop condition where position is held at a standstill and is UR robots’ safeguard stop is a 2011 edition, monitored as a safety function. Category 2 stop is permitted safety-rated monitored stop, See clause 5.10.2 Safety-rated to auto reset. In the case of resetting and restarting SF2 on page 1. It is likely, in the monitored operation after a safety -rated monitored stop, see ISO future, that “safety-rated monitored stop 10218-2 and ISO/TS 15066 as resumption shall not cause stop” will not be called a form of hazardous conditions. collaborative operation.
